items.title: Sam Dutrey Interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You're named after your famous father.

ctx.x: I'll make a note that we're recording an interview with Mr. Sam Dutre at 731 St. Peter Street. This is Bill Russell interviewing, and the date is April the 14th, 1962. Do you mind giving your full name, Mr. Dutre?
You're named after your famous father.
